_comment: Metadata for the TheraPlay activity library import (php artisan activities:import-library). Every entry was written after looking at the actual file. difficulty_basis is 'source' when the material itself says Beginner/Intermediate, otherwise 'assessed' from the task. review=true marks a judgement the owner may want to check. Files come from TheraPlay_Activities_Organized.zip (not committed).

activities.title: Shadow Matching Pets
activities.description: A one-page worksheet with four pets (dog, cat, rabbit and fish) and four black shadows. The child connects each pet to its shadow.
instructions: Draw a line from each animal to its shadow.

activities.title: Shadow Matching Body Parts
activities.description: A one-page worksheet with six body parts and bones (hand, foot, finger, ear, tooth and bone) and their shadows. The child connects each picture to its shadow.
instructions: Draw a line from each body part to its shadow.

activities.title: Shadow Matching Vehicles
activities.description: A one-page worksheet with six vehicles (bicycle, plane, school bus, sailboat, helicopter and tractor) and their shadows. The child connects each vehicle to its shadow.
instructions: Draw a line from each vehicle to its shadow.

activities.title: Turn Taking Visual Games
activities.description: A short guide to using a visual turn-taking board, with printable "My turn" and "Your turn" cards. The sheet suggests using names, photos, favourite characters or shapes to show who goes next.
instructions: Print the "My turn" and "Your turn" cards.
Use the cards to show whose turn it is during a game or activity.
Names, photos, favourite characters or shapes can be used to show who has the next turn.

activities.title: Scavenger Hunt Indoor Outdoor
activities.description: A picture checklist scavenger hunt. The garden page lists a bee, bird, daisy, stones, ladybird, leaves, feathers and butterfly, each with a box to tick when it is found. The document has three pages.
instructions: Look for each item shown on the checklist.
Tick the box when you find it.

activities.title: Bored Choice Boards
activities.description: A "Bored Board" with an "I pick..." box and eight picture choices: make slime, make a straw rocket, make a paper snowflake, scavenger hunt, pick a Lego challenge, pick from the bored jar, make your own playdoh and paint a picture.
instructions: Look at the picture choices on the board.
Pick one choice and place it in the "I pick..." box.

activities.title: Conversation Chain Activity
activities.description: A conversation game using chain links. Each person who stays on the topic adds a green chain link. A red broken link is added when someone goes off topic.
instructions: Pick a topic of conversation as a starter.
Each time a person stays on the topic, add a green chain link.
If someone goes off topic, add a red broken chain and talk about what this means.
You can keep a tally of how many green chains you got in each conversation.
materials: Printed chain links and topic cards

activities.title: Emotion Recognition Game
activities.description: Three card games for practising facial expressions: a game of snap, copying an expression, and picking the card that matches an expression.
instructions: Game one: play a game of snap with the cards.
Game two: pick one card and ask the child to copy the facial expression shown. You can ask when they have felt that way.
Game three: make a facial expression and see if the child can pick up the matching card.

activities.title: Conversation Starter Game
activities.description: Conversation cards with five questions each on topics such as food, the beach, movies and school.
instructions: Pick a card.
Take turns asking and answering the questions on the card.

activities.title: Flower Number Sequencing 1 to 10
activities.description: Number cards showing flowers beside three number choices (the first page shows one flower and two flowers). Review: the title mentions sequencing, but the first page is a count-and-choose-the-number card.
instructions: Look at the flowers on each card.
Choose the number that matches how many flowers there are.

activities.title: Cookie Number Sequencing 1 to 10
activities.description: Number cards showing cookies with chocolate chips beside three number choices (the first page shows one chip and two chips). Review: the title mentions sequencing, but the first page is a count-and-choose-the-number card.
instructions: Count the chips on each cookie.
Choose the number that matches.

activities.title: Skip Counting by 2s Ocean
activities.description: Ocean-animal cards with a number pattern that has one missing number (for example 2, __, 6, 8), and three numbers to choose from.
instructions: Read the number pattern on the card.
Choose the number that fits in the blank.

activities.title: Skip Counting by 5s Farm
activities.description: Farm-animal cards with a number pattern that has one missing number (for example 5, __, 15, 20), and three numbers to choose from.
instructions: Read the number pattern on the card.
Choose the number that fits in the blank.

activities.title: Fruits and Vegetables Alphabet Activity
activities.description: A small alphabet book of fruits and vegetables with a cover that has a line for the child's name. Each page shows a letter with a picture (for example Aa avocado, Bb blueberries, Cc carrot).
instructions: Print the pages and put them together as a book.
Look at each letter and its picture together.

activities.title: Winter Scavenger Hunt
activities.description: An outdoor picture checklist with ten items to find: robin, bare tree, leaves, stones, fence, clouds, puddles, berries, footprint and twig.
instructions: Go outdoors and look for each item on the checklist.
Tick the box when you find it.

activities.title: Color Matching Colors
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity. One set of colours goes on a folder and the matching set is cut out to attach with Velcro.
instructions: Attach one set of colors to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout color to the same color on the folder.

activities.title: Color Matching Ice Cream
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity using ice creams.
instructions: Attach one set to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout ice cream to the same colored ice cream on the folder.

activities.title: Color Matching Cupcakes
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity using cupcakes.
instructions: Cut out one set of cupcakes and attach the other set to a folder.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match the cutout cupcakes to the cupcakes with the corresponding color on the folder.

activities.title: Color Matching Trains
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity using trains.
instructions: Attach one set to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout train to the same colored train on the folder.

activities.title: Color Matching Whales
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity using whales.
instructions: Attach one set of whales to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match the cutout whales to the same colored whales on the folder.

activities.title: Color Matching Crayons
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity where coloured crayons are matched to crayon boxes.
instructions: Mount the coloring boxes to a folder and cut out the crayons.
Match the colored crayons to the same colored crayon box.

activities.title: Color Matching Rocketships
activities.description: A cut-and-stick colour matching activity using rocket ships.
instructions: Attach one set of rockets to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout rocket to the same colored rocket on the folder.

activities.title: Color Word and Icon Matching
activities.description: A cut-and-stick matching activity with colours, colour words and icons. The sheet says it includes activities with and without words.
instructions: Attach the set of colors or words to a folder and cut out the other set.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout to the corresponding color or word on the folder.

activities.title: Flower Pattern Matching
activities.description: A cut-and-stick matching activity using flowers with different patterns.
instructions: Attach one set of flowers to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout flower to the flower with the same pattern on the folder.

activities.title: Number Matching Cookies
activities.description: A cut-and-stick number matching activity. Cookies with a number of chips are matched to cookies with the matching number.
instructions: Color both sets of cookies.
Attach one set (either the chip set or the number set) to a folder and cut out the other.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match the cutout cookies to the cookies with the corresponding number or number of chips on the folder.

activities.title: Number Matching Pizza
activities.description: A cut-and-stick number matching activity. Pizza slices with pepperoni are matched to numbered slices.
instructions: Attach the pepperoni pizza slices to a folder and cut out the numbered pizza slices.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match the numbered pizza slices to the slices with the corresponding number of pepperoni.

activities.title: Number Matching Ice Cream
activities.description: A cut-and-stick number matching activity with numbered ice cream cones and ice cream scoops.
instructions: Attach the ice cream cone set to a folder and cut out the ice cream scoops.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match each cutout ice cream scoop to the corresponding numbered ice cream cone on the folder.

activities.title: Number Matching Gumballs
activities.description: A cut-and-stick number matching activity with gumball machines. Numbered machines are matched to machines with that many gumballs inside.
instructions: Attach the gumball machines to a folder and cut out the numbered machines.
Attach Velcro to both the folder and the cutouts.
Match the numbered gumball machines to the gumball machines with the corresponding number of gumballs inside.

activities.title: Number Lacing 1 to 10
activities.description: Printable number cards from 1 to 10. Each large coloured number has white circles on it (one on the 1, two on the 2). The sheet has no written instructions.
instructions: Print the number cards and use them with the child as the sheet shows.

activities.title: Number Dot to Dot 1 to 10
activities.description: Ten pages, each with a large outlined number from 1 to 10 and circles marked on it. The sheet has no written instructions.
instructions: Print the pages and use them with the child as the sheet shows, one number at a time.

activities.title: Brushing Teeth Beginner
activities.description: A beginner visual sequence strip with real photos for brushing teeth. The page also has tips for using sequence strips: personalize the visuals, place them where the task happens, use them consistently and fade prompts gradually.
instructions: Get toothbrush.
Get toothpaste.
Put toothpaste on toothbrush.
Turn on water.
Wet toothbrush.
Brush upper teeth.
Brush lower teeth.
Spit out toothpaste.
Rinse mouth.
Dry mouth.

activities.title: Washing Face Beginner
activities.description: A beginner visual sequence strip with real photos for washing the face, with tips for using sequence strips.
instructions: Get washcloth and face soap.
Turn water on.
Splash water on face.
Put face soap on washcloth.
Rub face with washcloth.
Rinse face.
Turn water off.
Dry face with a clean towel.
Put washcloth and face soap away.

activities.title: Washing Hands Beginner
activities.description: A beginner visual sequence strip with six real photos for washing hands (the photos have no captions), with tips for using sequence strips.
instructions: Follow the photos on the strip in order, from the running water to drying the hands.

activities.title: Brushing Teeth Intermediate
activities.description: An intermediate visual sequence strip with line drawings for brushing teeth, with the same tips for using sequence strips as the beginner version.
instructions: Get toothbrush.
Get toothpaste.
Put toothpaste on toothbrush.
Turn water on.
Brush teeth.
Rinse mouth.
Rinse toothbrush.
Turn water off.

activities.title: Washing Face Intermediate
activities.description: An intermediate visual sequence strip with line drawings for washing the face, with the same tips for using sequence strips as the beginner version.
instructions: Get washcloth.
Get face soap.
Turn water on.
Wash face.
Turn water off.
Dry face.

activities.title: Washing Hands Intermediate
activities.description: An intermediate visual sequence strip with line drawings for washing hands, with the same tips for using sequence strips as the beginner version.
instructions: Turn water on.
Get soap.
Rub hands.
Turn water off.
Dry hands.

activities.title: Visual Schedule Beginner
activities.description: Version 1 (beginner) of a visual schedule that uses real-life images. It includes a guide called "How to Implement a Visual Schedule" and picture cards. Seven pages.
instructions: Read the guide on how to implement a visual schedule.
Place the symbols in the order the activities will happen.
At the start of the day, review the symbols with the child by pointing to each one and naming the activity.
materials: Printed schedule pages and picture cards

activities.title: Visual Schedule Intermediate
activities.description: Version 2 (intermediate) of a visual schedule that uses animated photos. It has the same "How to Implement a Visual Schedule" guide and picture cards. Seven pages.
instructions: Read the guide on how to implement a visual schedule.
Place the symbols in the order the activities will happen.
At the start of the day, review the symbols with the child by pointing to each one and naming the activity.
materials: Printed schedule pages and picture cards

activities.title: Maze and Path Tracing
activities.description: A worksheet called "Shapes and mazes for tracing" with a cross, circle, square, star and triangle path. Each path has a start arrow and an end square. The document has four pages.
instructions: Start at the arrow.
Trace along the dashed line to the end square.

activities.title: Word Spacing Practice
activities.description: Cut-out "Spacekid" figures to use as a spacer between words when writing.
instructions: Print the page on heavy paper.
Let the child choose a favorite spacekid and decorate it with crayons, markers and other art supplies.
Cut it out and glue it to a pencil, a craft stick or the handle of a plastic spoon.
While writing, have the child place the spacekid between words to leave enough space.
materials: Pencil, craft stick or plastic spoon

activities.title: Writing Between Bold Lines
activities.description: Bold line paper: bold solid lines with a dashed line in each row. The sheet has no written instructions.
instructions: Print the bold line paper and use it for writing practice.

activities.title: Name Tracing and Writing
activities.description: A name tracing worksheet. The example name (Emma) is shown in light letters, then dotted letters, then blank lines to write on. There are lines for name and date.
instructions: Trace the name, then try it on your own.

activities.title: Shape Tracing
activities.description: A tracing worksheet with seven shapes: circle, square, triangle, rectangle, star, heart and diamond. Each row has one model shape and five dashed shapes to trace.
instructions: Start at the green dot.
Trace each dashed shape.

activities.title: Straight Line Tracing
activities.description: A pre-writing tracing worksheet with straight down, straight across, slanted lines, zigzags, waves, bumps and loops.
instructions: Start at the green dot.
Trace each dashed line.

activities.title: Uppercase and Lowercase Letter Tracing
activities.description: A 52-page set of letter practice pages (one page for each uppercase and lowercase letter). Each page has five steps, for example "Capital A practice".
instructions: Trace the letter. Follow the dashed letter.
Start at the dot and write the letter.
Copy the letter beside the model.
Write the letter from memory.
Trace the example word and say the word as you write.

activities.title: Word and Sentence Copying
activities.description: A 12-page handwriting practice booklet. Pages include "Write on the Line" (sun, moon, star, tree) and "Copy the Words" (sun, cat, dog, ball). Review: the pages checked contain single words; the other pages were not checked in detail.
instructions: Trace the gray model first.
Write the word again on your own with neat, even letters.
Keep every letter sitting on the line.

activities.title: Basic Pre Writing Strokes
activities.description: A 12-page pre-writing tracing booklet marked for ages 2 to 5. Each page practises one stroke, for example "Horizontal Lines" (age 2-3).
instructions: Start on the green dot.
Trace the dotted lines, copying the colored model.

activities.title: Pre Writing and Handwriting Checklist
activities.description: A checklist and note sheet for adults. It lists pre-writing strokes by age (for example imitating lines and a circle, copying a cross, square and triangle) and has a note sheet with boxes for a child's drawings. Review: this is an observation sheet, not a worksheet for the child.
instructions: Use the checklist to note which pre-writing strokes the child can imitate or copy.
Record what you see on the note sheet.

activities.title: Homemade Play Dough
activities.description: An activity card for making play dough from flour, salt, water and oil, then squeezing, flattening, rolling and shaping it.
activities.objective: The card lists: tactile exploration and hand strength.
instructions: Mix the flour and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add water and a little oil until the mixture forms dough.
Let the child squeeze, flatten, roll and shape the dough.

activities.title: Rice Scooping Bin
activities.description: An activity card for scooping and moving uncooked rice between cups with a spoon.
activities.objective: The card lists: tactile exploration and hand-eye coordination.
instructions: Place a small amount of rice in a basin.
Give the child a spoon and two cups.
Let them scoop and transfer the rice between the cups.

activities.title: Texture Matching
activities.description: An activity card for touching different household materials and matching the ones that feel similar. The card shows the words soft, rough, bumpy and smooth.
activities.objective: The card lists: tactile discrimination and describing textures.
instructions: Place the materials on a table.
Let the child touch each material and find the ones that feel similar, such as two soft fabrics.
Ask the child to match the materials.

activities.title: Laundry Basket Push
activities.description: An activity card where the child pushes an empty laundry basket across the floor.
activities.objective: The card lists: body awareness and gross motor coordination.
instructions: Place the basket on a flat, nonslip floor.
Ask the child to push it from one point to another.
Repeat a few times, allowing breaks when needed.

activities.title: Towel Delivery
activities.description: An activity card where the child carries towels in a basket to a table and stacks them.
activities.objective: The card lists: body awareness and participation in household tasks.
instructions: Place a few lightweight towels in the basket.
Ask the child to carry the basket or individual towels to a nearby table.
Let them stack the towels neatly.

activities.title: Dough Squeeze and Roll
activities.description: An activity card for squeezing, rolling and flattening play dough and making small balls or simple shapes.
activities.objective: The card lists: hand strength and body awareness.
instructions: Give the child a ball of dough.
Ask them to squeeze, roll and flatten it.
Have them make several small balls or simple shapes.

activities.title: Cushion Step Over
activities.description: An activity card where the child steps over low, firm cushions on the floor with an adult nearby.
activities.objective: The card lists: balance and movement planning.
instructions: Place the cushions securely on the floor.
Ask the child to step over each cushion slowly.
Offer support if needed and remove the cushions if they are unstable.
materials: One or two low, firm cushions

activities.title: Follow the Line
activities.description: An activity card where the child walks along a taped line on the floor.
activities.objective: The card lists: balance and motor coordination.
instructions: Make a short line on a clear floor.
Ask the child to walk along the line at a comfortable pace.
Repeat if they are comfortable and able to do so safely.
materials: Painter's tape or a straight line marked on the floor

activities.title: Gentle Weight Shifting
activities.description: An activity card where the child stands holding a chair or counter and slowly shifts their weight from one foot to the other.
activities.objective: The card lists: balance and body awareness.
instructions: Ask the child to stand with feet comfortably apart.
Have them slowly shift their weight from one foot to the other.
Repeat a few times while holding the support if necessary.
materials: Stable chair or counter for support

activities.title: Copy My Rhythm
activities.description: An activity card where an adult taps a simple pattern and the child copies it.
activities.objective: The card lists: auditory memory, attention, and imitation.
instructions: Tap a simple pattern, such as two slow taps.
Ask the child to copy the pattern.
Gradually introduce different patterns depending on their ability.

activities.title: Household Sound Hunt
activities.description: An activity card for listening to familiar household sounds, such as a fan or clock, and naming or pointing to them.
activities.objective: The card lists: auditory attention and sound identification.
instructions: Sit with the child in a quiet area.
Listen for nearby sounds.
Ask the child to identify the sound or point toward where it comes from.
materials: Familiar household sounds, such as a fan or clock

activities.title: Copy the Pattern
activities.description: An activity card for copying a colour pattern made with large blocks, such as red, blue, red.
activities.objective: The card lists: visual discrimination, sequencing, and problem-solving.
instructions: Arrange three objects in a pattern, such as red, blue, red.
Ask the child to create the same pattern.
Add more objects as the child becomes comfortable.
materials: Large colored blocks, crayons, or colored paper

activities.title: Find the Hidden Object
activities.description: An activity card where a toy is partly hidden behind another object and the child finds it.
activities.objective: The card lists: visual scanning, attention, and problem-solving.
instructions: Partly hide a toy behind another object while keeping it visible and reachable.
Ask the child to find the toy.
Give simple clues if needed.

activities.title: Water Pouring Station
activities.description: An activity card for pouring a small amount of water between cups on a tray, with a towel for spills.
activities.objective: The card lists: visual-motor coordination and tactile exploration.
instructions: Place the cups on the tray with a small amount of water in one cup.
Show the child how to pour water into another cup.
Encourage slow pouring and wiping any spills.

activities.title: Food Texture Exploration
activities.description: An activity card for looking at, smelling or touching two familiar foods with different textures, without having to taste them.
activities.objective: The card lists: food-related sensory exploration and expressing preferences.
instructions: Offer two familiar foods that differ in texture.
Let the child look at, smell, or touch the food without requiring them to taste it.
Encourage them to communicate which texture they prefer.
materials: Small portions of familiar foods with different textures

activities.title: Arrow Direction Matching
activities.description: A worksheet called "Match the directions!" with five rows of black shapes. The first shape in each row has to be found again among shapes turned in different directions.
instructions: Look at the first shape in each row.
Circle the matching shape in each row.

activities.title: Find the Differences Superhero A
activities.description: A find-the-differences worksheet with two pictures of a superhero boy (one with the letter B and one with the letter A on the shirt).
instructions: Circle the FOUR differences between the pictures.

activities.title: Find the Differences Superhero B
activities.description: A find-the-differences worksheet with two pictures of a superhero girl. The differences are small, such as the shape and colour of the symbol, the stripe and the trousers.
instructions: Circle the FOUR differences between the pictures.

activities.title: Letter M Visual Scanning
activities.description: A visual perception worksheet with rows of the letter M and a few letter Ns mixed in. Review: the file name says M, but the sheet asks the child to find the letter N.
instructions: Find the letter N and color it.

activities.title: Letter Combination Search
activities.description: A worksheet with many three-letter combinations made from w, n and m in different orders. The child finds the ones that match the combination in the top box (wnm).
instructions: Find 10 letter combinations that look the same as the one in the top box.
Circle them.

activities.title: Letter Matching Grid A
activities.description: A worksheet with the letters A to F. In each row the first letter must be matched to the choices, which are turned or flipped.
instructions: In each row, circle the letter that is the same as the first letter.

activities.title: Letter Matching Grid B
activities.description: A worksheet with six rows of capital letters (G, J, F, D, S, C). In each row the child finds the letters that match the first one.
instructions: In each row, circle the letters that are the same as the first letter.

activities.title: Letter Search Grid
activities.description: A worksheet of small letters (a, b, c, d, p and q) that are turned or flipped in many directions. The child finds the letter d.
instructions: Draw a diagonal line in each d.

activities.title: Letter H Visual Scanning
activities.description: A worksheet with a grid of capital letters. The child finds every letter H.
instructions: Find all the H's.

activities.title: Number Three Visual Scanning
activities.description: A worksheet called "Find 3" with numbers scattered in a box. The child counts how many 3s there are and writes the answer.
instructions: Find the number 3 in the box.
Count how many 3s there are and write the answer on the answer line.
